shared_elements: circular disc or round feature on the body/face area
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both present a vertically oriented frontal anthropomorphic form with internal geometric markings, including round features and band-like linear motifs. The biggest difference is that A is a detailed full-bodied, limb-bearing, ornamented figure holding or flanked by implements, whereas B is a much more abstract block-like face/body image dominated by a large facial roundel and simple bands.
